systems.platform: satellite internet with off-grid solar power
systems.owner: Ministère du Développement numérique, des postes et des télécommunications, with the World Food Programme
systems.tiers: six sites operational in Androy and Anosy on the Vohitsova-Antanimora axis at February 2026, about 10,000 beneficiaries by the minister's account

systems.system: IT equipment for 11 local entities under Smart Village
systems.owner: Ministère du Développement numérique, des postes et des télécommunications
systems.tiers: 11 entities including districts, hospitals, schools, gendarmerie services, communes and agricultural services in Androy and Anosy; the number of communes is not given

note: The satellite connection is at community digital centres for residents; communes are among 11 entities given IT equipment, with no connection of a commune office stated.
